doc.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Philadelphia roots and arrival in New York
title: High-school peers and Byard Lancaster
summary: Few schoolmates stayed in music; Byard Lancaster in the marching band did.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Coming up, were there any other either friends or school associates that were also in music, that went on to be successful?
Because we know Philly is a hotbed for musicians.

Oh yeah. I had – when I was in junior high – no, high school, actually – I had a little trio, but I think I was the only one who continued in music. But in the marching band, there was a saxophonist named Byard Lancaster who was – we were in the band together. He went on. He took a different direction, but he continued in the music.
